deadline.value: Priority deadline for Fall is November 15 on the Cell Biology track page; the department says applications open in early August.

also.quote: The application cycle is usually open from early August through Nov. 15th for admission the following Fall semester.

gre_general.value: The department says the GRE is not required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

toefl_min.value: The department's track page requires TOEFL iBT 94.

ielts_min.value: The department's track page requires IELTS 7.0.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver for international applicants. Domestic applicants had a free week (Oct 19-26, 2026).
fee_waiver.quote: There are no application fee waivers being offered for International Applicants.

supervisor.value: You can apply without contacting faculty, but naming faculty whose research matches yours in the statement helps.
supervisor.quote: No, you can apply without contacting faculty members. | It will help if you are familiar with the research of our faculty

funding.value: Unconditional admission includes a graduate assistantship with a stipend, tuition coverage and some health insurance.
funding.quote: Unconditional acceptance in both our MS & PhD programs includes a graduate assistantship position that comes with a stipend, tuition coverage, and some health insurance benefits

entry_route.value: Bachelor's graduates and master's holders both apply; the credit requirement differs by entry path.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the program with a bachelor's degree must complete a minimum 20 credit hours | Students entering the program with a master's degree should consult with their guidance committee

notes: Three Ph.D. tracks: Cell Biology and Molecular Genetics, Ecology and Evolutionary Biology, and Integrative Physiology and Neurobiology (also tagged neuro). Deadline and English minimums come from the Cell Biology track page; the Ecology track page was not fetched. The graduate school table also lists 94/7.0 for all biology programs.
